correctness.rationale: The source tricritical lambda,sigma reduce the 3-compartment ODE exactly to sdot=-eta*s+gamma*i-(gamma+eta)*s*i and idot=eta*s*i-gamma*i^2 on the invariant simplex. With r=s/i, R=gamma/eta, rdot=gamma-eta*r-eta*i*r*(r+1) and idot=eta*i^2*(r-R); every r=R crossing is strictly downward; if r0>R a crossing occurs by finite comparison, else i decreases. Eventual i decreases to 0 and r tends R. Stable-filter expansion r-R=-R(R+1)i+R(R+1)(2R+1)i^2+O(i^3) yields idot=-K*i^3+L*i^4+O(i^5) and reciprocal-square integration gives c0=(2K)^-1/2 and c1=L/(2K^2)=(2gamma+eta)/(2gamma(gamma+eta)), remainder O(t^-3/2 log t). Independently checked parameter coefficient algebra and 3 ODE peak regimes; numerical trajectories are not proof of global convergence or asymptotics.
